jurisdiction.name: Cabo Verde
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Cabo Verde has no AI law or standalone AI strategy. AI appears as a commitment to implement an AI strategy, alongside regulatory sandboxes, in the 2024-2030 Digital Economy Strategy, and as a gap identified in the May 2026 orientations for a Digital Agenda 2035. The binding rules come from the data protection law as amended in 2021, which gives a right not to be subject to solely automated decisions, including profiling, and a right to know the logic of automated processing.
narrative.review_notes: This review was completed on 12 October 2026 and covers national law, government, ministries and regulators. The national AI strategy committed to in the digital economy strategy has not been published and is listed as a lead.

instruments.official_title: Resolução n.º 88/2024 — Aprova a Estratégia da Economia Digital de Cabo Verde (EEDCV) para o período de 2024 a 2030
instruments.english_title: Resolution No. 88/2024 approving the Digital Economy Strategy of Cabo Verde (EEDCV) 2024-2030
instruments.issuing_authority: Council of Ministers (Conselho de Ministros); coordination by the Ministry of Digital Economy and the Directorate-General for Telecommunications and Digital Economy (DGTED)
instruments.summary: Council of Ministers resolution (approved 24 September 2024, published in Boletim Oficial I Série n.º 93 of 4 October 2024) approving Cabo Verde's Digital Economy Strategy 2024-2030, with an executive summary annexed and the full text announced at www.med.gov.cv/eedcv. It sets six pillars and 37 strategic objectives; under the Market and Innovation pillar, objective MI 9 is to 'implement an AI strategy' and MI 7 to create regulatory sandboxes, while the Governance pillar includes promoting and regulating new technologies (GP 4) and the Security pillar strengthening data protection (SR 3). The Ministry of Digital Economy coordinates and DGTED coordinates initiatives.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: The only adopted national strategy that commits Cabo Verde to producing a dedicated AI strategy; no standalone AI strategy had been published by October 2026.
instruments.current_status: In force as the national digital-economy strategy; Resolução 72/2026 (May 2026) refers to it as the EEDCV 2025-2030 and directs its consolidation into a Digital Agenda 2035.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): Boletim Oficial I Série n.º 93 of 4 October 2024 (6 pages) downloaded from boe.incv.cv and read with pdftotext; Resolução 88/2024 text and annex read in full. Status note: The full strategy is announced at www.med.gov.cv/eedcv, which did not resolve on 2026-10-12; only the gazetted executive summary was read.

instruments.official_title: Resolução n.º 72/2026 — Procede ao balanço da agenda de transformação digital em Cabo Verde e estabelece orientações para definição de uma Agenda Digital de Cabo Verde 2035
instruments.english_title: Resolution No. 72/2026 reviewing Cabo Verde's digital transformation agenda and setting guidelines for a Digital Agenda of Cabo Verde 2035
instruments.summary: Council of Ministers resolution (approved 6 May 2026, Boletim Oficial I Série n.º 54 of 7 May 2026) that takes stock of Cabo Verde's digital strategies (EEDCV, Digital Governance Strategy 2021-2024, Digital Governance Action Plan 2023-2025, PEDS II) and sets orientations for consolidating them into a Digital Agenda 2035 with eight axes. Among the gaps it identifies are the only partial incorporation of new trends 'notably artificial intelligence (AI), the data economy, digital public infrastructure and agentic automation' and insufficient maturity in adopting AI and data analytics; it also calls for updating the legal and institutional framework and an indicator-based monitoring model.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Most recent government policy act naming AI as a gap to be addressed in the forthcoming Digital Agenda 2035.
instruments.current_status: In force from 8 May 2026; the Digital Agenda 2035 it orients had not been found as a published document on 2026-10-12 (see leads).
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): 8-page act PDF from boe.incv.cv read in full with pdftotext.

instruments.official_title: Lei nº 121/IX/2021, de 17 de março — Procede à segunda alteração do regime jurídico geral de proteção de dados pessoais das pessoas singulares aprovado pela Lei nº 133/V/2001, de 22 de janeiro
instruments.english_title: Law No. 121/IX/2021 of 17 March, second amendment of the general legal regime for the protection of personal data of natural persons (Law No. 133/V/2001)
instruments.summary: Second amendment of Cabo Verde's general data protection law (Lei 133/V/2001, previously amended by Lei 41/VIII/2013), published in Boletim Oficial I Série n.º 28 of 17 March 2021. Amended article 14 gives everyone the right not to be subject to a decision producing legal or similarly significant effects based solely on automated processing, including profiling, with exceptions for legal authorisation or contract with safeguards, and amended article 11 gives data subjects the right to know the logic of automated processing for automated decisions; the law also adds definitions of profiling, pseudonymisation and biometric data and impact-assessment obligations. The preamble records that Cabo Verde has been a party to Convention 108 since 1 October 2018.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: The binding rules on automated decision-making and profiling that apply to AI systems processing personal data; there is no AI-specific law.
instruments.current_status: In force (30 days after publication). The CNPD also hosts the text at https://www.cnpd.cv/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Lei-121.IX_.2021-alteracao-Lei-41.VIII_.2013.pdf. No consolidated official republication of Lei 133/V/2001 was found.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): Boletim Oficial I Série n.º 28 of 17 March 2021 (34 pages) from boe.incv.cv read with pdftotext; articles 11 and 14 and preamble read; act title confirmed on the act view page View/49460.

organizations.name: Council of Ministers
organizations.ai_governance_role: Government of Cabo Verde in Council of Ministers; approved the Digital Economy Strategy 2024-2030 (Resolução 88/2024), whose objective MI 9 is to implement an AI strategy, and Resolução 72/2026 setting orientations for a Digital Agenda 2035 that flags AI as an under-integrated trend.

organizations.name: National Assembly
organizations.ai_governance_role: Parliament; enacted the personal data protection regime (Lei 133/V/2001 as amended by Lei 121/IX/2021, incl. the right not to be subject to solely automated decisions incl. profiling) and approved Convention 108 for ratification (Resolução 49/IX/2017).

No qualifying AI-governance document was found for ethics, risk and assurance, procurement, cybersecurity, standards, readiness indices, sector rules, generative AI, drafts and consultations, international agreements, or past instruments. No AI bill found.; Government: Digital Economy Strategy 2024-2030 (Resolução 88/2024) and Resolução 72/2026 recorded; Resolução 24/2026 (Semana do Digital) read, no AI content; governo.cv 'Governo em Ação: Economia Digital' brochure (2026) only announces an AI centre of excellence, not an instrument. No national AI strategy or public-sector AI guideline found.; Ministries: Searched, nothing found: no AI-specific documents from education, health, justice, defence, finance, labour or interior ministries in the gazette or via web search; NOSi 2025 activity plan mentions an AI project (NOSi Kriol) only as a project.; Regulators: CNPD site reviewed (guidance, directives, opinions/decisions, legislation): only the Feb 2026 AI-imagery joint statement. ARME, BCV: searched, nothing AI-specific found.. Not reached: ARME and Banco de Cabo Verde sites not crawled page by page (web search only); parlamento.cv bill tracker not searched directly. Could not verify: Full EEDCV text at www.med.gov.cv/eedcv (host does not resolve). ethics, risk-assurance, procurement, cyber-security, standards, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found.
